name: EMS, Inc (Electronic Manufacturing Solutions)
old_description: With over 19 years of experience in delivering superior products.
about:
EMS, Inc. operates a 20,000-square-foot facility in Lincoln, Arkansas. The company was founded in 2007 and has grown into a full-service electronics contract manufacturer serving OEMs across the United States.

The company provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing under one roof, including PCB design and layout, surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly (with BGA and QFN capability), cable and wire harness assembly, electro-mechanical box build, test fixture design, design-for-manufacturing analysis, component procurement, and rework/repair. It handles prototype through high-volume production runs.

EMS serves industries such as oil and gas, transportation and logistics, IoT, agriculture, fitness, HVAC, automotive, trucking, medical, aviation, food packaging, telecommunications, emergency services, energy, product marking, industrial motor manufacturing, automation, and railroad. Recent projects include a cavity-mounted sensor for transportation, a motor control board and downhole monitoring system for oil and gas, a motor assembly for industrial automation, and a cardio equipment console for fitness.

The company emphasizes a single-location model that reduces handoffs, offering clear quotes, on-time delivery, and direct access to the engineers building each product. It also specializes in labor-intensive "dirty jobs" that can slow customer production lines, aiming to provide a shorter, more reliable supply chain.
built_on: All manufacturing services (design, assembly, test) under one roof

capabilities: PCB design & layout (schematic capture, multilayer, high-speed, flex/rigid-flex)
PCB assembly (SMT, through-hole, BGA, QFN, conformal coating, potting)
Cable & wire harness assembly (custom cables, wire harnesses, crimping, termination, ribbon/FEP/ETFE/PFA cables)
Box build / electro-mechanical assembly (sub-assemblies, system integration, software integration, enclosure fabrication)
Test fixture design & manufacturing (ICT, functional, wireless, mechanical)
Design for manufacturing (DFM) (design rule check, component analysis, thermal analysis, signal integrity)
PCB component procurement (rapid sourcing, anti-counterfeit, obsolete parts, logistics)
PCB rework & repair (component replacement, solder mask repair, failure analysis, circuit modification)
